adaptation: The fixtures preserve exact original source slices. Runtime functions are not verbatim ports: JSON file, trust, and exposure scaffolding is replaced by existing typed account TOML storage and enabled-only project scope.

copies.label: project merge and override
replacements: Global then project Map loading becomes typed account TOML resolution keyed by canonical projectRoot.

Deciding expression value.command === undefined && value.url === undefined is retained; the upstream && value.type === undefined is omitted because existing transports use command/url and override policy excludes type.
Deciding spread { ...base.config, ...value } becomes { ...base, enabled: value.enabled } because enabled is the only project override policy.
Deciding replacement servers.set(name, { name, config, source: path, scope }) becomes servers[name] = value plus derived source metadata; no connection-field merge occurs for full definitions.
Unknown transport and orphan override diagnostics belong to the retained section owner.

copies.label: scoped policy update
replacements: JSON editMcpServers becomes RuntimeConfigOwner.mutateSection with selected-state digest CAS.
Only enabled is supported; semantic upsert preserves unrelated TOML and authored true overrides.

copies.label: scoped removal
replacements: JSON rewrite becomes selected semantic subtree removal under one account publication.
Global removal prunes dependent enabled-only entries across projects but retains full project definitions and credentials.

copies.label: account identity
replacements: Existing account credential store remains unchanged: server name plus SHA-256 URL, no scope in identity.
Do not copy upstream JSON auth storage, namespace normalization, legacy URL migration or refresh locks.

copies.label: scoped enabled actions
replacements: Global-without-override eligibility entry.scope === global && !entry.override becomes definitionScope === global && enabledScope === global; account-private choices need no repository trust or project JSON path.
Enable/Disable and Enable/Disable in this project labels and inverse enabled choice are retained in shared protocol selectors, with enabledScope directing the plain action.
Reconnect, tools, exposure and signout actions are omitted; authentication retains its existing protocol action and saved credentials are never deleted.

omissions: Repository-controlled project JSON and trust are replaced by private canonical-project entries in account TOML.
Exposure and toolExposure policies are omitted; only enabled overrides are admitted.
No transport, generic trust framework, config watcher, credential store, remote revocation, or sign-out port.
